jobs.title: FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone. 



We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Osmo's finance function is still being built, and that's the opportunity. The Office of the CFO needs a partner who can bring financial rigor to a company moving fast, keep the organization running day to day, and give department leaders a counterpart they can trust with real decisions — not someone who waits to be handed a finished process.

This role owns the full range of FP&A work: modeling, budgeting, reporting, and business partnership across the company. You'll be trusted with real ownership from day one, and the tenacity to chase down a broken process until it's actually fixed, the curiosity to ask why a number looks the way it does instead of just reporting it, and the kindness to make that pressure feel like partnership to the people you work with, will matter as much as the technical skill.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Corporate Model — Maintain, extend, and defend the long-range P&L, cash forecast, and scenario analyses that anchor company decisions, including one-off models for calls like make-vs-buy, pricing, headcount ROI, and capital allocation.

 - Run Department Budgeting — Build and maintain department-level budgets, track actuals vs. plan monthly, and own the variance narrative — not just reporting the gap, but working with the business leader to explain why it happened and what it means.

 - Partner on Close — Support month-end close with the Controller and own the financial reporting deliverables and management reporting package that come out of it.

 - Support the Board and Investors — Prepare board- and investor-facing materials: slides, data room exhibits, ad hoc analyses, and due diligence support during active fundraising.

 - Build the Data Infrastructure — Design and maintain the pipeline connecting business systems to the corporate model, automating the manual bridges that exist today rather than living with them.

 - Automate the Recurring Work — Build and maintain automations for reporting, reconciliation, variance alerts, and close checklists — curiosity applied to the question of what shouldn't require a human every month.

 - Apply Real AI Judgment — Evaluate new AI tools with genuine curiosity, and the discipline to know what's worth building, what's worth buying, and what's not worth the distraction.

 - Be Finance's Front Door — Serve as the primary point of contact for department heads, translating the numbers into plain language and surfacing the right questions with the kind of directness that earns trust.

 - Own Cross-Functional Projects — Take on work that doesn't fit cleanly inside one department — this is the CFO's execution resource when something needs a financially-minded owner with the tenacity to see it through.

 - Run Operational Infrastructure — Own vendor management, contract administration, compliance filings, and platform administration that keep the company running.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experienced in FP&A — 4-8 years in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, or a comparably rigorous financial analytical role.

 - A Real Modeler — You can build a clean, auditable model from scratch, and you have the curiosity to notice when one is wrong instead of trusting it blindly.

 - An Independent Owner — You've carried significant work end to end across multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders, with the tenacity to push things to done.

 - A Sharp Writer — Concise, well-organized, no wasted words.

 - Tech-Forward — You use AI tooling actively, have some comfort with scripting or APIs, and treat automation as a first-order part of the job, not an afterthought.

 - Comfortable in the Gray — You make reasonable judgment calls with incomplete information rather than waiting for permission.

 - ERP Fluent — Experience with ERP or accounting systems at the transaction level; NetSuite preferred.




WAYS TO STAND OUT

 - Built Something Before — You've built or maintained data pipelines, automations, or integrations in a finance context, not just used the ones someone else built.

 - Startup-Tested — Experience at a venture-backed startup (Series A/B/C) in a finance or business operations capacity.

 - Investor-Facing — Exposure to investor relations, due diligence, or fundraising processes.

 - Systems Fluent — Familiarity with Ramp, JustWorks, or similar spend management and HRIS platforms.

 - Technically Grounded — Background in a technically complex or industrial industry — AI/ML, chemicals, biotech, life sciences, manufacturing, or similar.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - Flexible PTO and paid family leave

 - 401(k) savings plan and employer match

 - Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

 - Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. Depending on the role, this may include base salary or contract-based pay, along with access to health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match; flexible paid time off and company holidays; and equity or incentive compensation for eligible roles. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other relevant business considerations. Osmo regularly reviews pay ranges and compensation structures to ensure they remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with current market data.  

All employment decisions and responsibilities are determined based on current ability and your ability to grow, without regard to race, color, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, religion, age, marital status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Osmo does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Osmo or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Osmo Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Osmo and Osmo will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire

jobs.title: Production Program Manager (Fragrance)
jobs.description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone. 



We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Osmo's customer programs don't end at signature — they succeed or fail in the handoff from creative work to real manufacturing. This role owns that handoff: the point where a customer's project moves from onboarding into production, fulfillment, and deployment, and where dropped threads become missed shipments.

You'll be the primary operational point of contact for customers after launch, and the person who keeps manufacturing, procurement, product development, quality, and delivery teams moving in the same direction. This is a role for someone who's tenacious about closing gaps before they become customer-facing problems, curious enough to actually understand how fragrance gets made rather than just tracking a spreadsheet of it, and kind in how they hold internal teams accountable to the commitments made to customers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Customer Relationship Post-Launch — Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned customers, building trust through proactive updates rather than reactive fire drills.

 - Coordinate Manufacturing Readiness — Track material availability, fragrance readiness, packaging readiness, and production milestones, and flag constraints before they become delays.

 - Align Production to Customer Commitments — Keep manufacturing priorities and deployment schedules in sync with what customers were actually promised.

 - Manage Orders End to End — Own customer orders from operational handoff through fulfillment, including schedule changes, order modifications, and status reporting.

 - Drive Cross-Functional Execution — Coordinate across Manufacturing, Procurement, Product Development, Quality, and Turnkey Delivery, holding teams accountable to timelines and service-level commitments.

 - Lead Escalations — Run execution reviews and escalation discussions when a project's milestones or a customer's expectations are at risk.

 - Catch Risk Early — Identify operational risks before they hit a customer commitment, and build and coordinate the mitigation plan.

 - Support Oil Shipment Planning — Coordinate readiness activities tied to oil shipments as part of the broader manufacturing handoff.

 - Improve the System, Not Just the Ticket — Support new tools, reporting, and workflows that increase visibility and scalability as Osmo's customer volume grows.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Operationally Fluent in Manufacturing — 8+ years across customer success, operations, manufacturing coordination, supply chain, or project management, ideally in the fragrance and flavor industry.

 - Comfortable in Customer-Facing and Plant-Facing Work at Once — Experience supporting customer-facing programs in manufacturing, consumer products, fragrance, or industrial environments — this isn't a pure customer-success seat or a pure production seat, it's both.

 - A Relentless Closer of Loose Ends — Tenacious about tracking every open thread across procurement, production, and customer communication until it's actually resolved, not just logged.

 - A Strong Cross-Functional Communicator — Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the judgment to know when to escalate and when to resolve quietly.

 - Genuinely Curious About How the Product Gets Made — Wants to understand fragrance readiness and production sequencing well enough to make real calls, not just relay updates.

 - Organized Under Pressure — Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer programs simultaneously without dropping any of them.




WAYS TO STAND OUT

 - Contract Manufacturing Experience — You've supported customer programs inside a contract manufacturing environment.

 - Production Planning Fluency — Familiarity with production planning, order fulfillment, or S&OP processes.

 - Systems Experience — Hands-on experience with ERP, CRM, and project management systems.

 - Launch Experience — You've supported product launches or customer deployment programs before, not just steady-state accounts.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6-12 MONTHS)

Customers feel informed, supported, and confident throughout project execution. Manufacturing priorities stay aligned with customer commitments and deployment schedules. Orders move efficiently through planning, production, and fulfillment, with risks and delays caught early and addressed proactively. Internal teams stay aligned on priorities, timelines, and responsibilities, and manufacturing readiness activities land on schedule with minimal surprises.



WHAT WE OFFER

 - Real Growth Path — Room to grow into a broader Customer Success & Operations leadership role as Osmo's customer volume and manufacturing footprint scale.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - 100% company-paid dental and vision coverage for employees

 - Flexible PTO and paid family leave

 - 401(k) savings plan and employer match

 - Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

 - Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. Depending on the role, this may include base salary or contract-based pay, along with access to health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match; flexible paid time off and company holidays; and equity or incentive compensation for eligible roles. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other relevant business considerations. Osmo regularly reviews pay ranges and compensation structures to ensure they remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with current market data.  

All employment decisions and responsibilities are determined based on current ability and your ability to grow, without regard to race, color, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, religion, age, marital status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Osmo does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Osmo or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Osmo Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Osmo and Osmo will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire
